info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Invoices-v2-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Invoices API provides access to invoice details associated with retail orders. This API allows users to retrieve information about invoices, including invoice amounts, payment statuses, and related order data. It is especially beneficial for businesses looking to streamline their billing and accounting processes. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, retail management systems, and financial reporting tools that require accurate and timely invoice information.

get.summary: Retrieve invoice details for an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the invoice details associated with a specific order. The invoice includes itemized charges, payment status, and other relevant information pertaining to the transaction.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve an invoice for the specified orders. This body must contain the necessary parameters in JSON format to successfully process the GET request for the invoice.

204.description: Request completed successfully; no content to return.

ListRetailOrdersInvoicesRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation related to invoice orders. Intended to convey a string value, typically used for identifying or filtering invoices.
